issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers defines a method named appendElement (appendElement(T[] array, T element)) while Stock.java in the template calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) — a different method name. The solution repository uses addElementToArray as well. This name/signature mismatch will cause compilation errors in the provided template and confuses students about which helper method to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent across artifacts. Rename the method in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...), matching Stock.java and the solution; or alternatively change Stock.java (and other callers) to call appendElement(...). Prefer aligning the template ArrayHelpers to addElementToArray to match the solution and provided Stock usage.

issues.description: The ArrayHelpers method used to append elements has inconsistent naming between repository artifacts: template Stock.java calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...), and the solution's ArrayHelpers implements addElementToArray(...), but the template's ArrayHelpers defines appendElement(...) instead. This naming mismatch for the same helper method will prevent compilation and confuses students about which method to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across artifacts. Rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) method to addElementToArray(...) so it matches the calls in Stock.java and the solution, or alternatively change calls to use appendElement(...) consistently. Prefer renaming appendElement to addElementToArray to match the existing Stock usage and the solution implementation.
